surface: SkillPath first onboarding / skill and goal selection

displayedOrder.prompt: Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography and purposeful spacing. Redesign the existing SkillPath first onboarding screen. Image 1 is the current app screenshot and edit target: preserve its warm understated product character and its purpose of choosing a learning goal, but improve its layout. Image 2 is the user-approved abstract alarm-clock brand logo: use this exact clock symbol in miniature with the SkillPath wordmark. Direction name: Goal First. Target dimensions: one portrait mobile app content screen at logical 390 x 844, same tall aspect ratio as the reference, full-bleed UI only. NO device bezel, body, notch, Dynamic Island, OS status bar, clock, signal, battery, home indicator, browser chrome, rounded device mask or device shadow. Current date anchor is Monday 2026-11-02, Asia/Shanghai; no date is needed on this onboarding screen. Keep the palette warm ivory #F3EFE5, muted sand #DDD8C8, dark charcoal #353830, terracotta orange #AC4E28. No dark green, purple, neon or rainbow gradients. Strong readable contrast. Body 14-16px, refined Chinese sans-serif, maximum two fonts. Small aligned header at top with approved alarm logo and SkillPath wordmark. This direction gives the user's own learning goal center stage: generous whitespace, big left-aligned headline exactly '今天，想学点什么？', supporting sentence '从一个小目标开始，安排属于你的学习节奏。'. A large elegantly integrated multiline goal input area on the base surface, subtle warm tint and a thin bottom rule rather than a big floating card; placeholder exactly '例如：每天15分钟，学会吉他弹唱'. Under the input, restrained section label '也可以从这里开始' and four compact suggestion pills '吉他' '摄影' '绘画' '编程'. Bottom area has one prominent solid orange full-width button exactly '生成我的学习计划', with small understated reassurance below '按你的时间，一点点学会。'. Focus on a calm beautifully composed editorial layout, clear vertical rhythm, excellent spacing, optical alignment, tactile but restrained app design. No cards inside cards, no metrics, streaks, progress dashboard, sign-in form, subscription, microphone or invented features. No decorative illustrations or book symbols. One primary action and only these few supporting choices. No presentation board, no labels identifying the option, no extra screen. Make all Chinese copy clean and accurately spelled.

No cards inside cards, decorative book shapes, dashboard metrics, streaks, sign-in, subscription, invented features, phone mockup, presentation board or option labels. In the central region a beautifully composed wide close-up real photographic crop of a light-wood acoustic guitar with visible strings, resting in soft warm daylight on a cream fabric surface; no people or hands, no text superimposed on the photo. Natural aspect ratio, subtle 16px corners, avoid artificial plastic 3D. Under it an editorial caption row with a bold title '吉他' and small selected check accent, secondary caption '从第一个和弦，到第一首歌'. Under the caption a simple compact horizontal skill switcher with three choices '吉他' selected, '绘画', '摄影', plus a quiet '更多' link; no pills inside cards or elaborate carousel controls. A lightweight secondary text entry link '有具体目标？直接告诉我' with a subtle arrow. Anchor the bottom with one strong terracotta full-width button '开始我的学习计划', and a small calm footnote '一点时间，也能慢慢学会。'. Strong composition, generous margins, rich but understated material warmth, excellent contrast, only one hero use case and one primary action. No book graphics, dashboard stats, streaks, schedules, login, subscriptions, invented features, decorative clutter, presentation board or option label. One polished calm premium mobile onboarding screen, accurately spelled Chinese.
